### Summary

At the pin the fourth-order face density reference has no switch of its own. It is part of
`dynamics/conversion-order: 4`, the deck key that also selects the fourth-order $x_1$ conversion between cell
averages and point values (@sec-ch04-conv4). This section keeps the key's selector, its guards and its registered
arms. The face rule itself is derived in @sec-ch05-wbref4 and is not repeated here. `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT` does
not turn this reference on. It shares only the three-ghost guard with this key.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Selects the reference face rule of @sec-ch05-wbref4, together with the conversion of @sec-ch04-conv4.

**Data.** The cell density reference and scan pressures in; the face density reference out.

**Placement.** In the $x_1$ reference, between the scan and the per-side face densities.

**Activation.** `dynamics/conversion-order: 4`; the default is 2.

**Guarantee / limits.** Unusable stencils, flagged cells and out-of-range faces keep the base face value.

**Evidence.** Tests below, @tbl-ch12-wb-reference-tests; solver ctests were not run.
:::

Local symbols: $\rho$[^rg-afba7fb0b9e7] is density [$\mathrm{kg\,m^{-3}}$] and $p$[^rg-f3f9358ec424] is pressure [Pa].

### Derivation

See @sec-ch05-wbref4 for the face rule and its guards. The chapter's own check line `[C2]` re-derives the face
rule independently: it integrates the quartic interpolant exactly [check
`src/snapy_report/ch12/checks/configuration_check.py`, output
`src/snapy_report/ch12/checks/configuration_check.out`]. The same line also verifies a five-point filter and a
cubic wall continuation, which no operator of the key uses.

### Numerical method

`HydroImpl::reset` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}}) refuses a `conversion-order`[^rg-4551bbe33cc4] other than 2 or
4. With nonzero $g_1$[^rg-a803b0bc6ed1] it refuses fewer than three ghost cells when the key is 4 or `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT` is on,
because the resolution flag reads scan pressures three cells away. With zero gravity the guard is inactive.

In `X1Reference::evaluate` ({{< code src/recon/x1_reference.cpp X1Reference::evaluate >}}), key 4 does three
things:

1. It builds the face-density rows with `face_density_rows` ({{< code src/recon/x1_rows.cpp face_density_rows >}})
   once per grid key. The rows are usable only with at least five cells and, next to a clamped wall, at least four
   owned cells. A block between two seams reads its exchanged ghosts instead.
2. It computes the resolution flag with `wb_ref4_flag` ({{< code src/recon/x1_reference.cpp wb_ref4_flag >}}) from
   this block's own scan pressures, and dilates it by two cells.
3. After the seam exchange of the cell reference rows, `wb_ref4_faces`
   ({{< code src/recon/x1_reference.cpp wb_ref4_faces >}}) writes the fourth-order face value. It keeps the base face
   value where the rows are unusable, where either neighbouring cell is flagged, or where the new value leaves the
   range of its two cells (relative margin $10^{-10}$).

The cell reference is not touched. The flag is local, so it needs no seam exchange.

#| fig-alt: "four cells and five faces with the weights of the interior and wall face rows."

### Code

**How to use it.** Set the key in the deck, and merge this fragment into a complete input card:

<!-- reader glossary keys -->Keys in this fragment: `geometry`[^rg-d507df17a90e], `cells`[^rg-3ae5045adadc], `nghost`[^rg-2629ff7b5445], `dynamics`[^rg-01ca350389d0], `forcing`[^rg-a13a781de491], `const-gravity`[^rg-138bbf245f63], `grav1`[^rg-96f8ca6235cd], `gravity-work`[^rg-334e37910182].
```yaml
geometry:
  cells:
    nghost: 3
dynamics:
  conversion-order: 4
forcing:
  const-gravity:
    grav1: -9.8     # m s^-2
    gravity-work: face
```

With radial gravity, `HydroImpl::reset` refuses a thinner halo. For two ghosts the message is
"SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT (or dynamics/conversion-order 4) needs nghost >= 3, got 2". The conversion's rows also
need at least four $x_1$ cells: `conv4_rows` ({{< code src/recon/x1_rows.cpp conv4_rows >}}) refuses fewer.

`X1Reference::evaluate` ({{< code src/recon/x1_reference.cpp X1Reference::evaluate >}}) contains this selection
step:

```cpp
  if (cfg.conversion_order == 4) {
```

Only the flag is computed inside it. The faces are written after the seam exchange, so a split column gets one
block's faces.

| what | code link | symbol | switch |
|---|---|---|---|
| key and default | {{< code src/options/hydro.yaml >}} | `conversion_order` | `dynamics/conversion-order` |
| guards | {{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}} | `nghost` | `dynamics/conversion-order` |
| rows | {{< code src/recon/x1_rows.cpp face_density_rows >}} | `usable` | `dynamics/conversion-order` |
| flag | {{< code src/recon/x1_reference.cpp wb_ref4_flag >}} | `wb_ref4_flag` | `dynamics/conversion-order` |
| faces | {{< code src/recon/x1_reference.cpp wb_ref4_faces >}} | `wb_ref4_faces` | `dynamics/conversion-order` |
| call | {{< code src/recon/x1_reference.cpp X1Reference::evaluate >}} | `wb4_flag` | `dynamics/conversion-order` |

: Implementation sites for the fourth-order reference selector. {#tbl-ch12-wb-reference-code}

1. Read the key, and refuse values other than 2 and 4. With gravity, refuse fewer than three ghosts. The anchor
   `nghost` is in {{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}}.
2. On each reference evaluation, build or reuse the rows, build the resolution flag, exchange the seam rows, and
   apply the face rule. The anchor `wb4_flag` is in {{< code src/recon/x1_reference.cpp X1Reference::evaluate >}}.

### Tests

| test (ctest name) | what it asserts | tolerance | where the tolerance comes from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_x1_seam_split_co4_face_density.<b>` (CUDA and two-rank variants registered) | with key 4, on a column cold enough that the flag switches on one cell above the seam, a split column keeps the one-block state | relative gap at most $10^{-13}$; recorded $x_1$ momentum to $10^{-9}$ relative | the test |
| `test_x1_seam_split_nghost_check_conversion_order_4.<b>` | with key 4 and gravity, one and two ghosts are refused with a message naming the key; three ghosts, or no gravity, set up | exception text; no throw | the test |
| `test_conversion_order_python` | key 4: the conversion's fitted order on uniform and stretched $x_1$ and on radial blocks, and the order of a gravity column, which takes the fourth-order face density | fitted order at least 3.8 | the script's docstring |
| `test_wb_ref4_order_python` (CUDA variant registered) | the order of the spurious stratification with the base face density (its deck does not set key 4) and `flux-covariance` on | slope at least 2.75 at the last doubling | `ORDER_ON` |
| `configuration_check.py` `[C2]` (report check) | the face moments | exact symbolic or Boolean equality | the independent check |

: Source assertions, not new solver measurements. {#tbl-ch12-wb-reference-tests}

The seam assertions are {{< code tests/test_x1_seam_split.cpp X1SeamSplit.co4_face_density_at_the_seam_split_matches_one_block >}}
and {{< code tests/test_x1_seam_split.cpp X1SeamSplit.nghost_check_refuses_fewer_than_3_ghosts >}}. The order
threshold is `ORDER_ON` ({{< code tests/test_wb_ref4_order.py ORDER_ON >}}), applied in `main`
({{< code tests/test_wb_ref4_order.py main >}}). The arms are registered in {{< code tests/CMakeLists.txt >}}.

No snapy runtime test is executed for this chapter. CUDA and multi-rank entries describe registration only.
The independent checks and their outputs are catalogued in @sec-ch16-ch12-tests.

The independent report check verifies the face moments in `[C2]`.[^ch12-wb-reference-run] The check itself is
unchanged, so its output line still reads `filter, cubic wall continuation and face moments`. Those two identities
belong to an operator the key does not have, and no claim here rests on them. The check models the stated contract
and does not execute the compiled solver.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
No fitted order of the key-4 face density is measured here. `test_wb_ref4_order_python`, despite its name, runs the
default conversion order. The guards can lower the effective order near walls and seams, and the interior moments
say nothing about wall or gnomonic convergence. The key's face density and its conversion cannot be selected
separately.

The complete switch inventory is @sec-ch12-matrix.
:::
